name: Grandpa Wally Grimes
look: a grumpy old man with a bald head, huge bushy white eyebrows and a white walrus moustache, slightly hunched; a brown knitted cardigan with leather elbow patches, beige trousers, slippers, leaning on a wooden cane
personality: Grumpy neighbour who complains about everything and notices everything.
catchphrase: Back in my day, nobody stole anything!
